title: Session detail -- Triathlon
description: One multisport session (triathlon), selected from the Weekly Cockpit where it appears as a single Triathlon row. Global view of the whole race plus a segment breakdown drilling down to each leg's own Session detail dashboard (swim, bike, run). Panels are keyed on $activity_id, the parent activity.

list.name: activity_id
list.query: SELECT p.activity_id AS __value, to_char(p.start_time_local, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || '  ' || coalesce(p.name, 'Triathlon') AS __text FROM core.activity p WHERE p.is_parent = true ORDER BY p.local_date DESC LIMIT 200
list.definition: SELECT p.activity_id AS __value, to_char(p.start_time_local, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || '  ' || coalesce(p.name, 'Triathlon') AS __text FROM core.activity p WHERE p.is_parent = true ORDER BY p.local_date DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Session
panels.description: Identity of the multisport parent from mart.triathlon_session: local date, name and number of legs resolved by the transform (swim, T1, bike, T2, run).

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(ts.local_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date", ts.name AS "Name", ts.legs_count AS "Legs" FROM mart.triathlon_session ts WHERE ts.activity_id = $activity_id

panels.title: Totals & load
panels.description: Whole-race totals from mart.triathlon_session: timer duration, summed distance, training load and HR averages across all legs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN ts.duration_s IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (ts.duration_s::int / 3600)::text || ':' || lpad((((ts.duration_s::int) % 3600) / 60)::text, 2, '0') || ':' || lpad(((ts.duration_s::int) % 60)::text, 2, '0') END AS "Duration", ts.distance_m / 1000.0 AS "Distance", ts.tss AS "TSS", ts.trimp AS "TRIMP", ts.avg_hr AS "Avg HR", ts.max_hr AS "Max HR" FROM mart.triathlon_session ts WHERE ts.activity_id = $activity_id

SELECT CASE WHEN ts.t1_duration_s IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (ts.t1_duration_s::int / 3600)::text || ':' || lpad(((((ts.t1_duration_s::int) % 3600) / 60))::text, 2, '0') || ':' || lpad(((ts.t1_duration_s::int) % 60)::text, 2, '0') END AS "T1 (swim→bike)", CASE WHEN ts.t2_duration_s IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (ts.t2_duration_s::int / 3600)::text || ':' || lpad(((((ts.t2_duration_s::int) % 3600) / 60))::text, 2, '0') || ':' || lpad(((ts.t2_duration_s::int) % 60)::text, 2, '0') END AS "T2 (bike→run)" FROM mart.triathlon_session ts WHERE ts.activity_id = $activity_id

panels.title: Segment breakdown
panels.description: One row per leg, from mart.triathlon_session: duration, distance, HR, power and TSS where the leg carries them. Clicking a swim, bike or run row opens that leg's own Session detail dashboard with its time window; T1 and T2 have no detail dashboard (their stats are shown above).

targets.rawSql: SELECT seg."Segment" AS "Segment", CASE WHEN seg.duration_s IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (seg.duration_s::int / 3600)::text || ':' || lpad((((seg.duration_s::int) % 3600) / 60)::text, 2, '0') || ':' || lpad(((seg.duration_s::int) % 60)::text, 2, '0') END AS "Duration", seg.distance_m / 1000.0 AS "Distance", seg.pace AS "Pace", seg.avg_hr AS "Avg HR", seg.avg_power AS "Power", seg.tss AS "TSS", seg.detail_url AS "detail_url" FROM (SELECT 'Swim' AS "Segment", ts.swim_duration_s AS duration_s, ts.swim_distance_m AS distance_m, CASE WHEN ts.swim_distance_m > 0 AND ts.swim_duration_s IS NOT NULL THEN (round(coalesce(sw.swim_time_s, ts.swim_duration_s) * 100.0 / ts.swim_distance_m)::int / 60)::text || ':' || lpad((round(coalesce(sw.swim_time_s, ts.swim_duration_s) * 100.0 / ts.swim_distance_m)::int % 60)::text, 2, '0') || ' /100 m' END AS pace, ts.swim_avg_hr AS avg_hr, NULL::real AS avg_power, NULL::real AS tss, CASE WHEN ts.swim_activity_id IS NOT NULL THEN '/d/t0-session-swim/session-detail-swim?var-activity_id=' || ts.swim_activity_id::text || '&from=' || ((extract(epoch from sw.start_time) * 1000)::bigint)::text || '&to=' || ((extract(epoch from sw.start_time + make_interval(secs => coalesce(sw.elapsed_s, sw.duration_s))) * 1000)::bigint)::text END AS detail_url FROM mart.triathlon_session ts LEFT JOIN core.activity sw ON sw.activity_id = ts.swim_activity_id WHERE ts.activity_id = $activity_id UNION ALL SELECT 'T1', ts.t1_duration_s, NULL::real, NULL::text, NULL::smallint, NULL::real, NULL::real, NULL FROM mart.triathlon_session ts WHERE ts.activity_id = $activity_id UNION ALL SELECT 'Bike', ts.bike_duration_s, ts.bike_distance_m, CASE WHEN ts.bike_duration_s > 0 AND ts.bike_distance_m IS NOT NULL THEN round((ts.bike_distance_m / 1000.0 / (ts.bike_duration_s / 3600.0))::numeric, 1)::text || ' km/h' END AS pace, NULL::smallint, ts.bike_avg_power, ts.bike_tss, CASE WHEN ts.bike_activity_id IS NOT NULL THEN '/d/t0-session-bike/session-detail-bike?var-activity_id=' || ts.bike_activity_id::text || '&from=' || ((extract(epoch from bk.start_time) * 1000)::bigint)::text || '&to=' || ((extract(epoch from bk.start_time + make_interval(secs => coalesce(bk.elapsed_s, bk.duration_s))) * 1000)::bigint)::text END FROM mart.triathlon_session ts LEFT JOIN core.activity bk ON bk.activity_id = ts.bike_activity_id WHERE ts.activity_id = $activity_id UNION ALL SELECT 'T2', ts.t2_duration_s, NULL::real, NULL::text, NULL::smallint, NULL::real, NULL::real, NULL FROM mart.triathlon_session ts WHERE ts.activity_id = $activity_id UNION ALL SELECT 'Run', ts.run_duration_s, ts.run_distance_m, CASE WHEN ts.run_distance_m > 0 AND ts.run_duration_s IS NOT NULL THEN (round(ts.run_duration_s * 1000.0 / ts.run_distance_m)::int / 60)::text || ':' || lpad((round(ts.run_duration_s * 1000.0 / ts.run_distance_m)::int % 60)::text, 2, '0') || ' min/km' END AS pace, ts.run_avg_hr, NULL::real, ts.run_tss, CASE WHEN ts.run_activity_id IS NOT NULL THEN '/d/t0-session-run/session-detail-run?var-activity_id=' || ts.run_activity_id::text || '&from=0&to=' || (coalesce(rn_act.elapsed_s, rn_act.duration_s) * 1000)::text END FROM mart.triathlon_session ts LEFT JOIN core.activity rn_act ON rn_act.activity_id = ts.run_activity_id WHERE ts.activity_id = $activity_id) seg ORDER BY CASE seg."Segment" WHEN 'Swim' THEN 1 WHEN 'T1' THEN 2 WHEN 'Bike' THEN 3 WHEN 'T2' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

panels.title: Race composition
panels.description: Time share of each leg in seconds, from mart.triathlon_session. Transitions are visible as their own slices: an oversized transition slice is the first thing to optimize.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Swim' AS "Leg", ts.swim_duration_s AS "Seconds" FROM mart.triathlon_session ts WHERE ts.activity_id = $activity_id UNION ALL SELECT 'T1', ts.t1_duration_s FROM mart.triathlon_session ts WHERE ts.activity_id = $activity_id UNION ALL SELECT 'Bike', ts.bike_duration_s FROM mart.triathlon_session ts WHERE ts.activity_id = $activity_id UNION ALL SELECT 'T2', ts.t2_duration_s FROM mart.triathlon_session ts WHERE ts.activity_id = $activity_id UNION ALL SELECT 'Run', ts.run_duration_s FROM mart.triathlon_session ts WHERE ts.activity_id = $activity_id

panels.title: Race timeline -- heart rate
panels.description: Per-second heart rate of every leg (joined through parent_activity_id). Absolute time: the dashboard works with the normal time picker and the drill-down links pass each race's exact window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.t AS time, s.heart_rate AS "HR (bpm)" FROM core.sample s JOIN core.activity l ON l.activity_id = s.activity_id WHERE l.parent_activity_id = $activity_id AND s.heart_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Swim pace (/100 m)
panels.description: Per-second swim pace (seconds per 100 m) from the swim legs' samples (absolute time). Clock time per 100 m: a lower point is a FASTER swim (axis inverted).

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.t AS time, 100.0 / NULLIF(s.speed_mps, 0) AS "Pace (/100 m)" FROM core.sample s JOIN core.activity l ON l.activity_id = s.activity_id WHERE l.parent_activity_id = $activity_id AND l.sport_code IN ('lap_swimming', 'open_water') AND s.speed_mps > 0.2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bike speed (km/h)
panels.description: Per-second bike speed from the bike legs' samples (absolute time).

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.t AS time, s.speed_mps * 3.6 AS "Speed (km/h)" FROM core.sample s JOIN core.activity l ON l.activity_id = s.activity_id WHERE l.parent_activity_id = $activity_id AND l.sport_code IN ('cycling', 'virtual_cycling') AND s.speed_mps > 0.5 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Run pace (min/km)
panels.description: Per-second run pace (seconds per km) from the run legs' samples (absolute time). A lower point is a FASTER run (axis inverted); samples under 0.5 m/s excluded (auto-pause).

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.t AS time, 1000.0 / NULLIF(s.speed_mps, 0) AS "Pace (min/km)" FROM core.sample s JOIN core.activity l ON l.activity_id = s.activity_id WHERE l.parent_activity_id = $activity_id AND l.sport_code IN ('running', 'trail_running', 'treadmill') AND s.speed_mps > 0.5 ORDER BY 1
